question: HA#543: the only red row is rounds-owed, and every quorum bot is unavailable (exit 9) or never creates a check at head. Where does the run end?

options.label: Sixth stop after a window ⭐ (Recommended)

options.label: Named terminus
options.consequence: A new named terminus (quorum-unavailable) hands the PR to you; it never reaches the sixth stop.

options.label: Leave unruled
options.consequence: Keep today's cap-reached terminus; #543 is delivered as documentation only.
